summary: Build and publish a signed macOS Axo app bundle with a monotonic local build number and rollback-safe atomic replacement.
trigger: A developer runs scripts/build-mac.sh on a configured macOS build host.

steps.action: Select a signing identity, reserve/increment a canonical build number under a lock unless explicitly supplied, and compile the Pi extension.
Build the optimized Bazel app with build stamping, unpack it into a private staging directory, and include the Pi extension JavaScript.
Set and verify source/build metadata, deployment-target agreement, launch-agent plist validity, executable versions, signatures and matching team identity.
Atomically publish the staged app: swap with an existing destination to preserve the previous bundle, or use exclusive rename when no destination exists.
